info.syllabusName: Tiếng Anh Nhà hàng - Khách sạn (English for Hospitality)
info.description: The course aims to equip learners with a basic knowledge of hospitality industry, practice of professional operations, improve management skills, and so on to help learners familiarize with working in a restaurant environment. The course will also provide specific, specialized skills of the work, helping learners deeply grasp the key issues of the hotel & restaurant businesses such as welcoming guests, accepting orders, clearing tables, handling complaints, etc.. so as to effectively apply them to their future actual work.
